name: Crucible Workshop No. 7
description: Workshop No. 7 is GLMZ's most decorated automaton combat workshop, competing in the MACHINE WARS autonomous arena series from their fabrication floor in the industrial Tier 2 Eastwall District. Founded in 2188 by engineer Osei Tamboli-Vreeland, the workshop builds and fields autonomous combat machines — not synthetic life — designed entirely in-house, with their signature hexapod chassis the 'Ironlark' series winning three consecutive MACHINE WARS championships.
story_hooks: A rival workshop has stolen the Ironlark's proprietary movement algorithm and Tamboli-Vreeland's team must prove it before the championship without tipping off the thieves.
During a post-match diagnostic, a machine's behavioral logs reveal it has been receiving external signal inputs during fights — someone is remotely influencing the autonomous machines.
A young engineer from the Shelf approaches the workshop with a radical chassis design that could dominate the league, but their background check reveals connections to an illegal Tier 1 combat ring.
